historicalReview.notes: Reimported roots and pivots checked. The themed room and live painting revisit were rendered on desktop. The armor is dressing; awakening logic is a recipe.

dining_revision.method: Three-board tabletop, component-aligned walnut PBR, woven claret PBR upholstery, and polished brass details. Packed texture sources are embedded in the GLB and the blend.
dining_revision.comparison: 90 non-dining nodes matched transforms, material names, triangle vertex sets, and all attributes within 1e-6; compare-interior-roots.py
dining_revision.visual_review: Independent Astra review inspected the in-game walnut grain, brass bands, upholstery, seams and studs from seated and oblique views in Quest Browser.

visor_revision.comparison: 93 non-visor mesh nodes matched the baseline. Brow, both rolled bars and five studs are seated into the curved guard.

candelabrum_revision.method: Smooth turned wax and brass, 32-sided foot bead, seated cup rims and continuous nine-ring curved iron arms.
candelabrum_revision.comparison: 94 nodes outside holder geometry, including all six flame sockets, retain transforms, material definitions and oriented triangle attributes.

armor_revision.method: Original die-shaped plate lofts, embossed laurel and sunburst, separate sallet, visor and gauntlet lames. Embedded 256 px planished steel base color, tangent normal and metallic-roughness maps.

visual_review.reviewer: Independent Astra Extra High visual review
visual_review.renderer: Chromium, ANGLE Metal on Apple M4
visual_review.notes: The final in-room view showed distinguishable gilded plate, visor, greaves and shoulders.
